title: Set Rule that changes nothing asks nothing and says so
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, tier A already 35% markup in every range.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, tier A already 35% markup in every range.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Check matrix A.
  4. Pick Markup % in the bar's rule picker.
  5. Type 35 in the bar's value.
  6. Click Set Rule.
  7. Check matrix B.
  8. Click Set Rule.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The count is 1.

Step 4:

  • Markup % is picked.

Step 5:

  • The value reads 35.

Step 6:

  • No question is asked.
  • A message reads tier A's name followed by "already uses 35% markup in that matrix".

Step 7:

  • The count is 2 (matrix A and matrix B checked).

Step 8:

  • No question is asked.
  • A message reads tier A's name followed by "already uses 35% markup in those matrices".
